SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(category), ''), '未分類') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM todos WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(category), ''), '未分類') ORDER BY label

SELECT levels.label, COUNT(t.id) AS count FROM (SELECT 1 AS priority, 'HIGH' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'MEDIUM' UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'LOW') levels LEFT JOIN todos t ON t.priority = levels.priority AND t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY levels.priority, levels.label ORDER BY levels.priority
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{deadline}, COALESCE(#{completed}, FALSE), CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END)
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{deadline}, status = CASE WHEN #{completed} = TRUE THEN 'DONE' WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE todos SET completed = #{completed}, status = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE todos SET status = #{status}, completed = (#{status} = 'DONE') WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
